meta.title: ABCN - Afropean Business & Culture Network
meta.description: An inclusive platform dedicated to elevating Afropean diaspora communities through business, culture, connection and cross-border opportunity.
meta.ogDescription: African roots. European horizons. Business, culture and community in motion.

home.heroLead: ABCN is a Frankfurt network for Afropean founders, professionals and creatives. We run business circles, cultural salons and programmes that connect people building between Europe and Africa.
home.heroAlt1: ABCN members in conversation at a community gathering
home.heroAlt2: Members connecting at an ABCN event
home.aboutLead: ABCN is an inclusive platform for the Afropean diaspora. We celebrate our cultures, connect our businesses, and open doors between Africa and Europe.
home.statement: Afropean Business and Culture Networks (ABCN) is an inclusive platform dedicated to elevating Afropean diaspora communities by celebrating their cultures and connecting their businesses, fostering visibility, opportunity, and cross-cultural collaboration.
home.audience1Copy: Building a venture across African and European markets, and tired of explaining the context every time.
home.audience2Copy: Working in European tech, business or culture, and looking for peers who share the reference points.
home.audience3Copy: Seeking genuine diaspora engagement rather than a logo on a panel, and partners who can actually open the corridor.
home.audienceNote: Come as you are. Bring what you know.
home.whatWeDoTitle: Four ways we bring people together
home.whatWeDoLead: Regular formats across Frankfurt, Europe and Africa.
home.format1Copy: Founder-to-founder and professional conversations about markets, careers, capital and growth.
home.format2Copy: Rooms for creativity, identity, food, design and storytelling - the lived Afropean experience.
home.format3Copy: Introductions that connect African and European ecosystems around practical opportunity.
home.format4Copy: A visible platform for the people shaping Afropean business and culture.
home.founderQuote: Meet the visionary behind ABCN, Harmonie Essome, a Tech CEO, speaker, and Afro-European business networker passionate about building sustainable bridges between African and European communities through business, talent, culture, and innovation.
home.founderBody: As the Founder & CEO of SoftXcloud GmbH and creator of multiple Afro-European initiatives, her vision is centered on transforming diaspora potential into long-term economic impact, workforce opportunities, and meaningful cross-cultural collaboration.
home.joinLead: Come as you are. Bring what you know. Follow ABCN's public community and connect with founders, creators, executives and organisations shaping the Afropean business and cultural ecosystem.
home.joinOverlayCopy: From intimate Growth Labs to investor summits, ABCN brings diverse innovators into the room where decisions are made.
home.joinVisualAlt: ABCN members in conversation at a community gathering

about.lead: ABCN began with a simple observation: the people building between Africa and Europe rarely had a room of their own. So we made one.
about.statement: Afropean Business and Culture Networks is an inclusive platform dedicated to elevating Afropean diaspora communities by celebrating their cultures and connecting their businesses — fostering visibility, opportunity, and cross-cultural collaboration.
about.mandatesTitle: Three things we do, every time
about.mandatesLead: The mandate behind every circle, salon and programme we run.
about.mandate1Copy: Honouring African and Afropean cultures, creative arts and lived experience, without translation or compromise.
about.mandate2Copy: Bridging founders, startups, operators and commercial ecosystems between European hubs and African markets.
about.mandate3Copy: Creating access to capital, boardrooms and international stages for diaspora innovators.
about.faq1Q: What is the Afropean Business and Culture Network?
about.faq1A: ABCN is a platform focused on bridging the gap between African and European communities through business, culture, networking and collaboration.
about.faq2A: Entrepreneurs, professionals, creatives, organisations and diaspora communities looking to connect, collaborate and grow across African and European spaces.
about.faq3A: To elevate Afropean communities by celebrating culture, increasing business visibility, and fostering meaningful cross-cultural connections.
about.closeLead: Come as you are. Bring what you know. Whether you are building a venture, sharing a craft, or partnering institutionally, there is a room here for you.
